public_payload.normalized_proposition: When venture capital runs out, OpenAI and Anthropic will be crushed by their trillion-plus commitments unless they reach the public markets.

statement.excerpt: OpenAI and Anthropic need endless venture capital to fund their operations, and when that runs out — unless they can make it to the public markets — they will be crushed under their trillion-plus in commitments.

from_speaker: unless they can make it to the public markets
crushed under their trillion-plus in commitments
our_interpretation: Endless is read as continuing dependence on outside funding, not a literal infinite sum.
For each company, the condition requires venture funding to become unavailable before it obtains public-market funding.
Crushed means default, insolvency, a distressed restructuring or forced contraction because obligations cannot be met.
The trillion-plus wording is treated as a combined commitments premise; the wording does not clearly assign that amount to each company.
USD is inferred from the US companies and financial context. No accounting basis or commitment schedule is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: For both companies, financing exhaustion before public-market access is documented, followed by inability to meet commitments and resulting default, distressed restructuring or collapse.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the condition occurs, a company demonstrably meets or sustainably discharges its commitments without public-market funding or financial distress. Different outcomes for the two companies require separate treatment.
